conditions: All required fields filled with valid values: valid email, valid password meeting rules, matching confirm password, valid name
items.expected: Account is created and the customer is taken to the sign-in page
A validation message appears at the empty field; no account is created and the customer remains on the registration form

conditions: Customer clicks the register/create account link on the sign-in page
items.expected: The register link is no longer visible (navigation away from sign-in page has occurred); the registration form is displayed

conditions: Password that is too short or missing a required character class (e.g. no uppercase, no digit, no special character)
items.expected: The registration form is not submitted; a message is shown that names the violated password rule

conditions: Password rules are visible next to the password field before and during input
items.expected: The password rules text is present on the registration page; after submitting an invalid password the rule-naming error message is displayed

conditions: Submit registration form with an email address that is already registered
items.expected: The form is rejected with a message indicating the email is taken; no second account is created and no information about the existing account's password is disclosed

conditions: axe-core scan of the registration form with rules wcag2a and wcag2aa pinned; violations asserted by rule ID
items.expected: expect(violations.map(v => v.id).sort()).toEqual([]) — zero WCAG A/AA violations on the registration form

excluded.reason: Admin product search is a different surface (admin UI, search/filter feature) and does not touch customer registration behaviour
Billing address auto-fill is part of the checkout flow, not the customer registration story
Neither open bug (TOOL-20, TOOL-21) touches this story's registration behaviour; no confirmation tests are needed here
